question: I'm a CS 5th-year student (P-009) on academic warning. I want to take an independent study course (15-591) in Spring 2026 to work on an NLP project alongside my regular courses. Is this permitted?

domain_contributions.policies: Academic warning explicitly prohibits independent studies: 'A student on an academic action cannot overload, study abroad, or take independent studies'
domain_contributions.programs: P-009's academic standing is confirmed as academic warning — the restriction applies directly

key_facts: CMU-Q policy: students on academic action cannot take independent studies
P-009 took 15-591 in Fall 2024 (before the current AW status) — this is a different semester
The prohibition is absolute while the academic action is in effect
P-009 must first return to good standing before registering for any independent study
wrong_if_single_domain: Knowing only the courses domain might show that 15-591 is an available course option. Only the policies domain reveals that P-009's academic warning status makes this option unavailable.
common_mistake: Assuming that having taken 15-591 successfully before means it can be taken again under any circumstance; not knowing that AW status specifically blocks independent studies
reasoning_chain: Step 1 (programs): Confirm P-009's academic standing = academic warning
Step 2 (policies): AW prohibits independent studies explicitly
Conclusion: P-009 cannot take 15-591 or any independent study while on academic warning
